peers.name: ADIT BIRL SUN LIF AMC LTD

bull_bear.body:
- Treasury book is the acquisition war chest: "With a 30.0% CAGR in Cash Flow from Operations, our treasury book reached ₹585 crore as of March 2026 — enabling us to actively explore inorganic growth avenues."
- Total investments stood at ₹650.8 Crores as on 30th June 2026, allocated Mutual Funds and SIFs 90.3%, FD & Bonds 7.9%, Debt AIF 1.7%, Direct Equity 0.2%; within the MF portfolio, Debt & Arbitrage is 62.4%, Hybrid MF 18.1%, Hybrid SIF 17.5% and Equity MF 2.0%.
- Acquisition #1: Karvy Stock Broking's MF AUM for an aggregate ₹151.00 cr (excluding taxes) in an all-cash deal completed 28 November 2021, bringing total AUM of ₹8,093 cr with a 90.4% equity component, 1,63,751 live SIPs worth ₹33.87 cr p.m., 4,81,282 live investors and 8,58,734 live folios.
- Acquisition #2: "Prudent acquired mutual fund assets of iFast aggregating to Rs 517 crore at an acquisition cost of Rs 2.26 crore."
- Acquisition #3: Indus Capital (Pune), all-cash, aggregate consideration of ₹123.75 crore of upfront plus deferred payments with the deferred component contingent on specified performance parameters; merger completed October 2025, bringing MF AUM ₹2,104 cr, PMS-AIF AUM ₹145 cr, 95% equity AUM share, ₹10.83 cr monthly SIP book and 3,571 active families.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Founded in 2003 and headquartered in Ahmedabad, the company describes itself as "among the top mutual fund distributors in terms of assets under management and commission received", operating a "unique business-to-business-to-consumer (B2B2C) model and technology-enabled investment and financial services platform".
- Ranked by CAMS as of June 2026 at 4th in Total AUM in Retail and 5th in Net Sales in Retail; per AMFI data the deck shows Prudent's overall rank moving from #12 in 2016-17 to #4 in 2024-25, and non-bank rank from #4 to #2.
- Follows an "open-source" distribution model, distributing mutual funds of AMCs "irrespective of their affiliation or size", and pitches itself as a cost-efficient retail sourcing channel for AMCs with significant presence in B-30 markets.
- Scale of the partner moat: "No of Individual + Corporate ARNs in India stood at 2,03,376# with every fifth MFD working with Prudent", and the top 100 MFDs contribute just 14.69% of AUM (top 50: 9.43%, top 10: 3.15%) as of 30 June 2026.
- Deck claims growth ahead of the industry: "Prudent's AUM grew at CAGR of 34%, versus Industry's 21% from 2016-2026" and "Prudent's Equity AUM grew at a CAGR of 41%, versus Industry's 27% from 2016-2026".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Regulatory history] The deck footnotes the regulatory headwinds absorbed since FY18 — "June-18 15bps reduction in TER, Oct-18 Ban on Upfront commissions, March-19 B-30 classified as less than 2l retail only, April -19 Revised TER, B-30 incentive structure kept in abeyance from Feb-23".
- [Shareholding] As of 30th June 2026: Promoters 55.31%, DII 21.88%, FII 13.98%, Non-Institutions 8.83%; largest named institutions are Zulia Investments Pte Ltd (Temasek Group) 6.69%, DSP Investment Managers 5.59% and Kotak Mahindra AMC 5.29%. Mcap (as on 24.07.26) ₹11,966 cr on a face value of ₹5.0.
- [Leadership] Chairman & MD Sanjay Shah (CA, 35 yrs experience), CEO & Whole-time Director Shirish Patel (MBA, 26 yrs), Non-Executive Director Chirag Shah (CA, 25 yrs, oversees insurance distribution) and CFO Chirag Kothari (CS, 20 yrs).
- [Stickiness claim] "Prudent Individual Equity AUM staying invested for more than 24 months is higher by 340 basis points Versus Industry" (62.9% vs 59.5%, data as of 31st March 2026), with AUM over 60 months age at 29.8% of Prudent's total individual AUM.
- [Down-cycle claim] On 12-month rolling returns from April 2010 to Jun 2026, in the 44 months where Nifty500 return was less than 0% (24.0% of 183 observations), average Prudent equity AUM growth was 11.7% versus average industry equity AUM growth of 1.6%.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Prudent Corporate Advisory Services as "A DIVERSIFIED PLAY IN WEALTH MANAGEMENT" — a technology-enabled B2B2C platform that distributes mutual funds and other retail financial products through an independent MFD partner network rather than owning the manufacturing of the products.
